_about: The project library the K-12 builder assigns standards to. A project carries the driving question and the student product; a standard is routed to the project whose keys best match its own skills and text. This is the same shape the Grade 2 export already had -- 87 standards sharing 19 projects -- so a project is written once and many standards land on it. Bands are K-2, 3-5, 6-8, 9-12.
